column3: Close to the Greek; the exclamation “Ha!” is rendered “Let us alone!”
Close to the Greek; “oppressed with a great fever” is rendered “sick with a high fever.”
NKJV includes “the Christ” in the demons' cry, following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “You are the Son of God.”
NKJV reads “Galilee,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Judea.”
